## Detailed Project Catalog

### 1. Algorithm Visualizer
- URL: https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/algorithm-visualizer
- Description: Interactive visualizer for understanding sorting algorithms (Bubble, Merge, Quick) and pathfinding algorithms (Dijkstra, A*).
- Tech Stack: React, JavaScript, HTML5 Canvas, Tailwind CSS

### 2. Shopease E-Commerce Platform
- URL: https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/shopease
- Description: Production-grade e-commerce application with product catalog, cart state management, user authentication, and Cashfree checkout gateway integration.
- Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Cashfree SDK

### 3. PDF Audio Reader
- URL: https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/pdf-audio
- Description: Python utility for extracting text from PDF documents and converting it into natural audio playback using Text-to-Speech (TTS) engines.
- Tech Stack: Python, PyPDF2, pyttsx3 / gTTS

### 4. AI Captcha Solver
- URL: https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/captcha
- Description: Deep learning model trained to segment and transcribe text/numeric captchas from images.
- Tech Stack: Python, TensorFlow/Keras, OpenCV

### 5. SmartMess Management System
- URL: https://ggauravky.vercel.app/projects/smartmess
- Description: Web portal for managing student hostel mess attendance, meal tracking, and monthly expense calculation.
- Tech Stack: React, Node.js, MongoDB
